records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At March 31, 2024, our dollar-based net revenue retention rate marginally declined from the year ended December 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At March 31, 2024, we had 387,050 individual users across 4,411 customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarters ended March 31, 2024 and 2023, we had revenues totaling $157.5 million and $139.0 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •$2.9 million increase in computer software and data center expenses due to higher spend on cloud hosting services as customers continue to migrate to the Google Cloud Platform, as well as an increase in software purchases; and

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended March 31, 2024, cash provided by operations was $50.4 million, resulting from net non-cash expenses of approximately $24.6 million, net income of $14.8 million, and net cash flows provided as a result of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $11.0 million.
